Sampled sections 1.2, 1.3, 2.1-2.3, 3.1-3.4, 4.2-4.4, 5.1, 5.3, 6.2 were checked mathematically; none of the 70 source locators could be verified because none of the seven cited books is legally readable (listed under Not verifiable). Library contracts opened at the pins; six cross-roadmap citations resolved on main; dependency check 0 problems; lake env lean exits 0 with only sorry warnings; one-tactic probe closed 0 of 44 theorems. The one automatic check that failed (a section header with no declaration under it) is real and is a format note; none set aside. Pull-request text agrees with the head.
